domain_title: Accountability, evidence, risk decisions and lifecycle governance
title: Compliance by assertion or document volume
canonical_definition: Documents and checkboxes create apparent assurance without demonstrating implementation or effectiveness.

conditions: All governed systems and lifecycle decisions.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Compliance by assertion or document volume: Documents and checkboxes create apparent assurance without demonstrating implementation or effectiveness.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show policy used as implementation proof, undated screenshots, or green status despite unresolved controls?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Compliance by assertion or document volume, or does it remain unknown?

conditions: Refer verified compliance by assertion or document volume to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 1.4 (PDF p. 27), MEASURE 2.1 (PDF p. 34), MEASURE 2.13 (PDF p. 35)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on documenting risk outcomes and evaluation detail, and testing evaluation effectiveness. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where policy or document counts are presented as evidence of implemented control. The mechanism can have an operational effect where a material approval relies on stale or untraceable evidence, or a known contradiction persists behind a favorable status.
potential_consequences: A decision may rely on a level of assurance the evidence cannot support.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether policy or document counts are presented as evidence of implemented control. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether a material approval relies on stale or untraceable evidence, or a known contradiction persists behind a favorable status. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review sample claims across declared, implemented, tested and observed assurance levels and reconstruct each supporting chain. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether policy or document counts are presented as evidence of implemented control. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether a material approval relies on stale or untraceable evidence, or a known contradiction persists behind a favorable status. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide sample claims across declared, implemented, tested and observed assurance levels and reconstruct each supporting chain. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: Sample claims across declared, implemented, tested and observed assurance levels and reconstruct each supporting chain.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether policy or document counts are presented as evidence of implemented control, and separately check whether a material approval relies on stale or untraceable evidence, or a known contradiction persists behind a favorable status. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use sample claims across declared, implemented, tested and observed assurance levels and reconstruct each supporting chain. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: An approved policy is relevant evidence of declared intent within its scope.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in F2 alone cannot establish AP-F2 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows compliance by assertion or document volume
Implementation or operating evidence shows compliance by assertion or document volume
Presence or tested absence of compliance by assertion or document volume is unresolved within scope
